{{Top|leg}}
An '''Electro-snare''' was a device used to [[Stun/Legends|stun]] a target or prey animal to capture it alive.<ref name="ETU">''[[Enter the Unknown]]''</ref>

Small and difficult to detect, yet simple and highly effective - to the point of being considered nearly foolproof - an electro-snare was one of the most humane traps on the market for capturing prey alive. Ubiquitous across the galaxy and sold by many different manufacturers, an electro-snare was little more than a tiny [[Power cell/Legends|power pack]], energy discharge node, and a [[Proximity sensor/Legends|proximity sensor]] fit into a tiny light weight metal frame.<ref name="ETU" />
